description: The plot illustrates how loss changes over training time for two training runs, shown as two line series with a legend (one labeled “Vanilla”). The x-axis is labeled “Training Time (s)” on a linear scale, spanning from 0 to 250,000 seconds with regularly spaced tick labels every 50,000 seconds. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick labels at 0.05 intervals. One series is a purple solid line with upward-pointing triangle markers (labeled “Vanilla”), starting near the top of the axis around 2.75 at early times and decreasing smoothly over time to about 2.50 at 250,000 s, with representative points around ~2.62 near 50,000 s, ~2.57 near 100,000 s, and ~2.52 near 200,000 s. The second series is a red solid line with circular markers, also starting near ~2.75 early and decreasing over time, reaching roughly ~2.49 by around 230,000–240,000 s, with representative values around ~2.61 near 50,000 s, ~2.56 near 100,000 s, and ~2.50 near 200,000 s. A green dashed horizontal reference line is drawn at loss = 2.50, and two green dashed vertical lines mark times near 200,000 s and 250,000 s; a green double-headed arrow between these vertical lines is annotated “1.26×,” indicating a highlighted span along the time axis between those two marked times.
